slides.title: Pharmaceutical sales from 2014-2020 show significant gaps versus targets
slides.message: Analysis reveals persistent and large discrepancies between actual sales and targets across multiple products and years, highlighting a critical misalignment in sales performance.
expected_evidence: Total absolute discrepancy by year chart
slides.notes: Start by framing the overall challenge of sales under- or overperformance relative to targets, setting the stage for deeper analysis.

slides.title: 2016 had the largest sales-target gap driven by a few key products
slides.message: The year 2016 recorded the highest total absolute discrepancy (16,574 units), with products N02BE and M01AB exceeding targets by over 170% and 220%, respectively.
expected_evidence: Bar chart of discrepancies by product for 2016
Table of top product discrepancies in 2016
slides.notes: Highlight the peak discrepancy year and its main contributors to focus attention on critical problem areas.

slides.title: Discrepancies cluster in mid-to-late years indicating target-setting or market shifts
slides.message: Discrepancies are not evenly spread but concentrate in years 2015-2020, suggesting evolving market dynamics or misaligned target methodologies over time.
expected_evidence: Line chart of yearly discrepancy trends
slides.notes: Explain temporal patterns to motivate investigation into causes beyond isolated incidents.

slides.title: Data quality issues in actual sales data may distort discrepancy analysis
slides.message: Anomalies such as invalid hour entries and zero values in sales data require cleaning to ensure accurate measurement and trend detection.
slides.notes: Address data integrity to justify recommended preprocessing steps before further analysis.

slides.title: Large, persistent discrepancies reveal gaps in sales planning and execution
slides.message: The scale and consistency of discrepancies indicate weaknesses in sales target setting, communication, and real-time performance tracking.
slides.notes: Transition from problem diagnosis to identifying organizational and process weaknesses.

slides.title: Implement strategic oversight to align sales campaigns with targets
slides.message: Enhancing cross-departmental communication and project visibility will improve alignment of sales and marketing efforts with realistic targets.
expected_evidence: Framework diagram of strategic planning and execution oversight
Case study summary from KanBo platform
slides.notes: Introduce first recommended action focusing on planning and execution improvements.

slides.title: Align KPIs and enable real-time sales force adjustments to boost effectiveness
slides.message: Tight KPI alignment and mobile-first dashboards empower sales teams to respond quickly and stay focused on priority goals.
slides.notes: Present second recommendation emphasizing data-driven sales force management.

slides.title: Enhance collaboration and risk management to improve sales outcomes
slides.message: Leveraging project management frameworks to foster teamwork and anticipate risks will increase delivery quality and customer satisfaction.
expected_evidence: Supporting evidence from KanBo healthcare sales insights
slides.notes: Complete recommendations with focus on collaboration and risk mitigation.

slides.title: Clean data, investigate root causes, and pilot project management strategies
slides.message: Immediate next steps include data preprocessing, detailed discrepancy analysis, and piloting recommended strategies with performance monitoring.
slides.notes: Outline actionable plan to operationalize insights and track progress.

slides.title: Mitigate risks from data quality and change management to ensure success
slides.message: Addressing data anomalies and securing stakeholder buy-in are critical to avoid derailment of improvement initiatives.
slides.notes: Highlight key risks and how to proactively manage them to safeguard the plan.
